entities.summary: Benjamin Bocquelet is a French and British animator, writer, director and producer. He is best known as the creator and executive producer of the Cartoon Network animated series The Amazing World of Gumball and its spin-off and revival series The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball. He was also the director of the 2003 short film The Hell's Kitchen.
